name: iq-dash
description: Import Quota Monitor — runs entirely on Google Sheets (Neon fully detached).

DATA_SOURCE.description: Data source. Default 'sheets'. Set to 'neon' only to use the legacy Postgres path.

SHEETS_DB_ID.description: Google Spreadsheet ID that backs the app.

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.description: Service-account JSON (whole file as one line) for Google Sheets access. REQUIRED on Heroku (no key file is committed).

REDIS_URL.description: Optional shared cache (recommended so the cache survives dyno restarts).
